structure.title: Apex — Agent Scheduling Daemon
structure.prefix_summary:
# Apex — Agent Scheduling Daemon

> Unified agent scheduler replacing ASL / FSC scheduler / A2A coordinator
> Created: 2026-03-20

nodes.title: What
nodes.summary:
## What

Go 单进程 daemon，管理 1000 并发 AI agent 的任务调度、预算控制、能力匹配。
运行在 SUPER (64核/377GB)，通过 UDS + MessagePack 服务 Python 和 TypeScript 调用方。

nodes.title: Why
nodes.summary:
## Why

- ARL-Tangram 论文 (arXiv:2603.13019) 启发：action 级资源建模比 trajectory 级高效 4.3x
- 原来 8 个组件名太碎 (ASL/FSC/A2A/clawapi/OMC/NanoClaw/OpenClaw/ClawMesh)
- Python + TypeScript 双运行时在弱 CPU 上开销大，Go 单进程解决

nodes.title: Architecture
nodes.summary:
## Architecture

```
apexd (Go, ~50MB)
├── Orchestration: submit_job, upsert_tasks, cancel
├── Execution: register_agent, heartbeat, pull_tasks, finish_task
└── Budget: request_action_budget, finish_action

Agents (1000x, PULL model)
├── Claude Code agents
├── Codex agents
└── Custom agents

Redis ← backing store only (snapshots, not hot path)
LiteLLM ← API gateway below Apex
```

nodes.title: Key Decisions (Claude × Codex × Gemini)
nodes.summary:
## Key Decisions (Claude × Codex × Gemini)

| Decision                    | Rationale                         |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Go over Rust                | 控制面并发，不是计算面性能                     |
| PULL over PUSH              | 自然负载均衡 + 崩溃自愈                     |
| UDS + MessagePack over HTTP | 50-100x faster, 低 CPU 开销          |
| Redis 降级                    | 单线程 Lua 脚本在 1000 agent 下是瓶颈       |
| LiteLLM 在 Apex 下面           | Apex = 调度脑, LiteLLM = provider 管道 |
| Planner agent 拆任务           | Daemon 不调 LLM，无智能                 |

nodes.title: Three-Layer Abstraction
nodes.summary:
## Three-Layer Abstraction

```
Job  ("给项目加 OAuth")      — 用户意图
Task ("写 auth middleware")  — 可调度单元，有依赖
Action (一次 Claude API 调用) — 计费粒度
```

nodes.title: Status (2026-03-20)
nodes.summary:
## Status (2026-03-20)

- Go daemon: 9 RPC, 4 packages, 25 tests, E2E passing
- Python prototype: 5 modules, 29 tests
- Python client: apex_client.py
- Capability matching: AllOf/AnyOf/Avoid/MinModelTier
- DAG cycle detection: BFS ancestor walk
- Research report: `apex/RESEARCH_REPORT.md`

nodes.title: Next Steps
nodes.summary:

5. Sharded state for >1000 agents
